White's family announced her death last month.

"Sally would have been 64 years old when she died," said her family in a statement.

The prime minister's wife, Julia Gillard, was unable visit White and her daughter, Joanna, at her home in England. Her son, Greg, who is a surgeon, posted on Facebook that he was with them.

British Prime Minister and spokesman, David Cameron also tweeted a tribute to White and noted her acting ability and contributions to society.
